note_tweet.text:
ChatGPT Dots vs Claude Duet: Two different visions of AI assistants.

ChatGPT Dots

- Always-on personal AI agents.
- Work independently using their own cloud computer.
- Connect with apps and services.
- Handle coding, research and complex projects.
- Remember preferences and improve over time.

Claude Duet

- Proactive AI assistant that works in the background.
- Connects with apps, email and calendars.
- Creates reports, spreadsheets and presentations.
- Delivers personalized briefings.
- Handles multi-step tasks with user approval.

 If you had to pick one as your personal AI assistant, which one would you choose?
